product.about: something on sale that can be ordered

fields.price_eur: current price in euros, as offered for sale
fields.in_stock: whether it can be ordered now

product.why: a product whose price nobody states is most likely not on sale: a review or an archive page, not an offer

event.about: something that happens at a time and a place

fields.date: the date it happens, as YYYY-MM-DD
fields.starts_at: the time it starts, as HH:MM

event.why: an event without a date can't be planned for
